description: Two-panel XRD figure (Fig. 2) on austenitic low-density steels: (a) 28Mn0Ni and (b) 15Mn5Ni. Each panel stacks three vertically offset diffractograms over 2θ = 40–120° (x-axis, degrees) with the y-axis labelled "Intensity (a.u.)" and no numeric y scale; the stacked traces are HR+CR (top), HR+CR+973 K (middle) and HR+CR+1173 K (bottom). Both panels carry the same legend: black square = γ (FCC), blue triangle = B2, red circle = κ-carbide. In (a), the HR+CR trace is marked only with γ squares (strong peak just above 43°, weaker ones near 51°, 75°, 90°, 96°, 115°); after 973 K a red κ-carbide marker appears near 40° and a blue B2 marker near 50°; after 1173 K no secondary-phase markers are printed and the peak set again matches γ. In (b), the HR+CR trace also carries only γ square markers in the printed image; the 973 K trace adds the red κ-carbide marker near 40° and a B2 marker near 50° where the peak is split into a doublet; the 1173 K trace carries blue B2 triangles near 50°, 78°, 95° and 110° plus γ peaks, with no κ-carbide marker. The figure therefore argues that κ-carbide and B2 form at 973 K and that residual B2 persists to 1173 K in the Ni-containing alloy but not in 28Mn0Ni.
measured_quantities: X-ray diffraction intensity (a.u., no numeric scale)

observations.observation: Each panel of Fig. 2 stacks three vertically offset XRD patterns covering 2θ = 40–120°; the x-axis is labelled '2θ (degrees)' and the y-axis 'Intensity (a.u.)' with no numeric intensity scale printed.
Both panels share one legend: black square = γ (FCC), blue triangle = B2, red circle = κ-carbide.
In panel (a) 28Mn0Ni, the HR+CR trace is marked only with γ (black square) symbols, at a strong peak just above 43° 2θ and weaker peaks near 51°, 75°, 90°, 96° and 115° 2θ.
In panel (a), the HR+CR+973 K trace carries an additional red κ-carbide marker near 40° 2θ and a blue B2 marker near 50° 2θ, alongside the dominant γ peak near 43° 2θ and a weaker peak near 51° 2θ.
In panel (a), the HR+CR+1173 K trace prints no B2 or κ-carbide markers; its peak set (≈43°, 51°, 75°, 90°, 96°, 115° 2θ) reproduces the γ positions of the HR+CR trace.
In panel (b) 15Mn5Ni, the printed markers on the HR+CR trace are black γ squares only; no blue B2 or red κ-carbide symbol is printed on that trace in the image.

The citing text states that in the cold-rolled condition the 28Mn0Ni sample shows γ-phase peaks while the 15Mn5Ni sample shows γ+B2 peaks; the image only prints γ square markers on the 15Mn5Ni HR+CR trace, so the figure does not confirm the B2 labelling of the cold-rolled 15Mn5Ni trace.
In panel (b), the HR+CR+973 K trace shows a red κ-carbide marker near 40° 2θ and a blue B2 marker near 50° 2θ, where the peak appears split into two closely spaced maxima.
In panel (b), the HR+CR+1173 K trace is marked with blue B2 triangles at roughly 50°, 78°, 95° and 110° 2θ in addition to the γ peaks, and no κ-carbide marker is printed.
The citing text states that upon heat treatment at 973 K additional peaks corresponding to κ-carbides and B2 appeared in both alloys.

The citing text states that after heat treatment at 1173 K the 28Mn0Ni alloy showed peaks corresponding to γ-phase only, whereas 15Mn5Ni exhibited peaks of both γ and B2 phases but no noticeable κ-carbide peaks.

The citing text states that the B2 diffraction peaks were more intense in the 15Mn5Ni alloy heat treated at 973 K than at 1173 K, interpreted as a higher volume fraction of secondary phases at the lower annealing temperature.
The citing text states that the observed decrease of B2 volume fraction with increasing heat-treatment temperature (from EBSD) corroborates the XRD results of Fig. 2.

In every trace of both panels the strongest diffraction maximum lies just above the 40° tick (γ-type position, near 43° 2θ), with all remaining maxima markedly weaker and no numeric intensities given.
The caption states that the figure shows XRD patterns of (a) 28Mn0Ni and (b) 15Mn5Ni alloy in HR + CR as well as in selected heat-treated conditions.

subfigures.description: 28Mn0Ni alloy, three stacked XRD traces over 2θ = 40–120° with Intensity (a.u.) on the y-axis: HR+CR (top, γ squares only), HR+CR+973 K (middle, red κ-carbide marker near 40° and blue B2 marker near 50° in addition to the strong γ peak), and HR+CR+1173 K (bottom, no secondary-phase markers, γ peaks only). Legend: black square = γ (FCC), blue triangle = B2, red circle = κ-carbide.

15Mn5Ni alloy, three stacked XRD traces over 2θ = 40–120°: HR+CR (top, printed markers are γ squares only), HR+CR+973 K (middle, red κ-carbide marker near 40° and blue B2 marker near 50° where the peak appears split/doubled), and HR+CR+1173 K (bottom, blue B2 triangles near 50°, 78°, 95° and 110° together with γ peaks, no κ-carbide marker). Same legend as (a).

unreadable_items: Peak 2θ positions are read only against the 10° tick spacing; no peak positions or d-spacings are printed on the patterns
Intensity axis of both panels has no numeric scale, so relative peak intensities cannot be quantified within a trace
The 5 lowest-index tick labels between the 10° major ticks are not individually legible at the supplied resolution
